speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain, MRI_Spine, Urinalysis, CBC, Electrolytes, and please describe the progression of your symptoms over the past few months.

I note your mention of slurred speech, rigidity, tremor, and orthostatic hypotension alongside the incontinence; these neurological signs suggest a central nervous system issue rather than an infection like cellulitis, so I must rule out conditions such as multiple sclerosis or a brainstem lesion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis

The symptoms of progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, slurred speech, rigidity, tremor, and orthostatic hypotension are classic signs of a central nervous system demyelinating disease, not cellulitis. The MRI results of the brain and spine, along with the other test results, will help confirm this diagnosis.
